notes: Historical and invalid outcomes are retained, not endorsed.
An active run is a partial snapshot, not a completed campaign.
State rows and job artifacts overlap; do not count both.
Input binaries, software builds, private documents and caches are excluded.
Local home paths, host/user names and private IP addresses are redacted.
Superseded disk measurements removed at user request. Edited records have content_sha256 and superseded_rows_deleted; original_sha256 remains the pre-redaction, pre-pruning source identity.
